'''Charlin''' was a young [[Da'shain Aiel]] after the [[Breaking]].  His brother is [[Alijha]] and his sister is [[Colline]].

==History==
He helped [[Lewin]], [[Luca (Aiel)|Luca]], [[Gearan]], and Charlin free [[Maigran]] and Colline from bandits. He is killed during the rescue.{{ref/book|4|25}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until many years after his death. He should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Charlin}}
